verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of data-training opt-outs, data-usage policies, or privacy commitments regarding customer data and AI model training for either the open-source Pipecat framework or the hosted Pipecat Cloud service. Since Pipecat Cloud is a real hosted product where such a policy could plausibly exist, this axis applies, but no evidence supports it. Missing for 10: any privacy policy, ToS clause, or documentation stating customer data is not used to train models, and no independent corroboration.
